### Issue

Issue Number: ref #987, ref #976, ref #1081, ref #231

The numeric/Arrow delivery tracked by #987 has landed separately. This PR retains the broader composition, performance/resource and review requirements in #976 and #1081; it does not close those issues.

### Problem and context

The retained numeric/Arrow, session result policy and uniquely constrained Node APIs have landed on main through component PRs. This PR now carries composition tools, regression tests, documentation and qualification evidence.

**Implementation is ready for independent review; merge gates remain open.** Head [7edc2427](https://github.com/nowledge-co/hawdb/commit/7edc242728bc7febd55f964027f947fbbc8866b9), tree `a1009059`, includes main `46bfde00`. Conflicts are resolved. On2026-10-19 the owner explicitly moved full performance/resource matrices and same-runner gaps to background supplemental verification; unfinished measurements are not passing acceptance.

Runtime campaigns retain their actual source, engine `311091da` and tree `6ea7fb5d`. Engine311 to c87 changes only whitespace in one `cfg(test)` C ABI assertion tuple. Later follow-ups change documentation and setup-action pins only; production sources are unchanged. On the same Darwin build path, normal/profiled opt FFI libraries match byte-for-byte before/after formatting and after commit. This supports scoped equivalence without relabeling measurements. FFI declared inputs and action keys need not match because its source glob includes test files.

### Implementation and tradeoffs

- Follow main's Node eligibility: a physical point seek and unique constraint in the query's own catalog, checked before source admission even for zero matches or `LIMIT 0`. Non-unique seeks return `UnsupportedPlan`; duplicates under uniqueness return `Execution(StorageIntegrity)`, without a cursor or partial Node row. Consumed snapshots use their own catalogs.
- Withdraw draft-only `MultipleMatches`/status19/`multiple_matches`. Preserve statuses 0–18 and descriptor layouts. C refusal tests verify all five sentinel fields are zero and no owners/admitted memory remain. Held-node fixtures declare and report `Item(id)` uniqueness in untimed setup.
- Session UInt64 `max_result_rows` defaults to 0/unlimited. Host `None`/`Some(0)` normalize to unlimited; low-level request `Some(0)` and `LIMIT 0` remain strict zero. Payload, memory, mutation and host ceilings stay independent.
- Streaming can deliver earlier legal batches before a later cumulative-budget error. The violating batch is refused and the error propagated; final zero owners proves cleanup, not atomic whole-result delivery. Owned APIs remain available and strict borrowed APIs do not silently copy unsupported results.

### Validation

Every result below keeps its source identity. Planned work and partial observations are not passing acceptance.

| Gate | Evidence and remaining work |
| --- | --- |
| Required checks | Current c87 root/FFI/Python fmt and locked strict Clippy, prek/hooks and 6 targeted C ABI Node tests pass (14 tests outside that module filtered). The initial independent FFI fmt failure is preserved: root workspace fmt did not cover that package. Engine311 minimal-WASM strict Clippy, executor575 pass/17 ignored, portable13 and contracts33 pass. |
| Local fuzz | The exact required local-only command passes 98 targets: 76 freshly executed, 22 reported Bazel-cached. All 98 logs are archived. Both residency halves freshly cover 16 seeds/992 state checks each. No fuzz campaign was added to CI. |

Platform logs verify `73711c6f`/tree `9210f4f8` (main4a2a4c4d plus7edc); Windows GC remains running, not passed. Previous0b13 Windows evidence remains historical. Comment6269971539 confirms review fixes with no further finding; formal approval remains missing. |

General:1786 pass/1 ignored; contracts33; Python357 pass/7 skipped and43 pass/1 skipped plus lock validation. No test filter, thread override or deadline reduction. Formatting equivalence is separate; raw job labels remain unchanged. |
| Original ordinary90/resource110 | Published audited snapshot contains 47/90 and 32/110 groups (30 ordinary comparable;17 non-comparable). Preserve all five cases, three hosts, two backends, 1k/100k/1M sizes, original samples/warmups, concurrency and 360-minute deadlines. The first30 comparable ordinary groups retain four adverse write-stage medians for 1k fill_bulk across Rust/Python and both backends: costs rise0.23%–2.79%, while complete-operation medians improve. Three samples per side do not establish significance or cause. Rust100k memory fill_bulk: baseline rejects query-result materialization at16MiB in all4 attempts; candidate fully validates100k rows/300k values in all4. All250 deliveries/210 measured mode samples preserve original references, warmups and seven rotating rounds. Every retained/Arrow pair in positive groups exceeds1.1 for complete-operation time. Failed attempts have no qualified latency ratio; expected refusal jobs leave the workflow failure visible. |
| Phase and setup failures | Original phase workflow ended with ten observed groups but only nine complete observations. Its six positive groups qualify31-sample phase costs. In file1M+1, owned reaches the row refusal; retained/Arrow fail untimed setup on the MVCC version-index budget and do not query. Separate checkpoint controls complete resource6 and negative phase3, retaining original budgets, full consumer,512-row mutations and31 samples/warmup. Fifteen explicit65536-row setup checkpoints remove that setup shadow; they do not replace the original9/10 or its costs/counts. |
| Write/heap/resource controls | Engine311 held-write12 is audited with original rotating rounds, uniqueness, parity, old/new values and release. Numeric held/no-reader medians include1.08825/1.07172 at1k memory/file and1.02637/1.00315 at10k. Python error-heap audits cover three probes and16 attempts/12 measured samples. Fixed3cdb baseline Go/whole-run24 attempts/9 probes are revalidated existing Darwin observations, not new c87 or Linux measurements. Supplemental retained/Arrow row failures have2/1 nonzero global native windows with consistent counters and no Arrow-pool deltas; neither leakage nor leak absence follows. |
| Rust lower-bound gap | Additional [same-runner control39232726821](https://github.com/nowledge-co/hawdb/actions/runs/39232726821) is running:100k select/fill, all three hosts and two backends, both revisions, three measured samples plus discard. It adds12 groups without replacing90/110. Baseline-then-candidate ordering is disclosed; signed host-minus-Rust gaps and conditional closure fractions are descriptive, not randomized causal evidence or a theoretical lower bound. |
| Earlier failures | Two complete7dee general runs each1783 pass/3 fail/1 ignored/322 filtered fail on differing checkpoint cases. Correctly filtered checkpoint85 pass is diagnostic only; an earlier unforwarded filter actually repeated the full failing partition. Original Python300s/Pydantic60s timeouts and the failed uncommitted TEST_TMPDIR proposal are preserved. Later passes do not establish cause. Independent disposition remains required. |

Native allocation traffic, live windows, foreign heap, phase work, whole-child RSS and successful/failed-operation timings remain distinct. Missing counters are not zero. Generic retained/Arrow conversion-timer zeros do not prove absent conversion cost. Native work/handoff residual is not pure conversion, and separately computed medians do not add. No whole-memory bound, production-tail, leak-absence or universal performance claim is made.

Source311 campaigns: [ordinary90](https://github.com/nowledge-co/hawdb/actions/runs/39221987077), [resource110](https://github.com/nowledge-co/hawdb/actions/runs/39221994638), [retained10](https://github.com/nowledge-co/hawdb/actions/runs/39222009845), [phase10](https://github.com/nowledge-co/hawdb/actions/runs/39222030620). Source/overlay/run identities are verified; predecessor campaigns and adverse outcomes are preserved.

[Latest evidence packet](https://github.com/nowledge-co/hawdb/tree/b63f1d59d76eee2adb9cf72dae9d84fb726b198e/qualification/runtime-evidence/311091da) has1076 hash-verified files, preserving original failures, runtime/control evidence, numeric20, five current-platform logs and historical Windows results, owner/policy decisions, trusted Prow states and frozen47/32 snapshots. Original numeric20 is complete:12 successful groups/1116 measurements and8 expected-refusal groups/744 measurements, with31 per mode plus discard. Raw Prow GCS retrieval returned403; raw cloned-source/test counts remain unverified. Publication lint/hooks pass. Earlier7dee evidence/source scopes remain preserved in this packet and its linked historical packet.

### Compatibility and risks

Latest review cleanup: remove `docs/PR986_REVIEW.md`; align all three setup-bazel calls to0.19.1; add historical engine/source and scoped regeneration headers to seven documents. The withdrawn sizing objection leaves enormous/long unchanged. YAML, fmt, locked strict workspace Clippy and prek/hooks pass; no new runtime measurement is claimed. Table-scoped MVCC remains documentation-only future work.

This PR preserves main's experimental eligibility, errors, statuses/layouts, independent budgets and safe durability defaults. Main contributes0.11 release metadata; this PR does not authorize a release or stable Mem inclusion/activation. Payload handoff has bounded eligibility; arbitrary storage-to-host zero copy is not established.

Before merge: independently dispose of earlier failures, pass required current-head CI, obtain genuine maintainer approval and use normal Tide. Full90/110 matrices and gap interpretation are background follow-up under #976/#1081, not merge blockers. Current-head Prow started automatically; no `/test all` comment was needed. Standalone CI is not Prow/Tide status.

Thirty removed raw-report blobs remain feature-history reachable. Observed main46bf history and the production tree exclude them. Preserve the squash-only path and audit actual final main history for all30 blob IDs after integration. Historical Prow checkout metadata unavailable403 remains unverified.

### Release note

```release-note
Retained query composition qualification, regression and resource/performance evidence. Final acceptance and independent approval remain pending.
```

### Issue

Issue Number: ref #987, ref #976, ref #1081

#987 is closed following the independently delivered numeric/Arrow work. #976 and #1081 remain open. This PR still requires the complete composition, performance/resource acceptance and genuine independent approval described below; it does not close those remaining requirements.

### Problem and context

Bulk query results incur host conversion/copying costs, while indexed-node reads need independently releasable immutable owners. This PR composes experimental retained/Arrow and indexed-node delivery through the embedded Rust facade and C/Go/Python bindings, with explicit admission, lifetime and refusal behavior.

### Implementation and tradeoffs

- Main already contains the separately delivered session policy, ordinary benchmark tools, retained numeric core/bindings and task-budget enforcement. Independently approved Arrow #1071 actually landed through Tide as `6db1c013`. Indexed-node component #1082 is Ready, directly against main, with all 12 eligible checks passing; genuine independent review remains pending. Its approval does not replace this PR's complete acceptance.
- Eligible numeric/point views have independent immutable owners, aggregate admission, zero prefetch and provisional delivery until successful EOF. Unsupported plans/layouts, source-reuse and writable requests refuse explicitly. Produced payload is not canonical-storage-to-host zero copy.
- Session `max_result_rows` is UInt64, default **0 = unlimited**. Host None/Some(0) normalize to unlimited; low-level request Some(0) and query LIMIT 0 retain strict zero semantics. Independent payload, memory, mutation and host ceilings remain enforced. Exceeding a budget must not publish partial success or mutation.
- Reservations cover applicable payload/source/wrapper/descriptor capacity. Output-account observations do not prove whole-operation RSS bounds. Arrow, C/Go/Python views and indexed-node delivery each retain their eligibility and lifetime contracts.
